The host integrates the core. File/module boxes are explicitly marked; there is no second lifecycle.
typed config / paths / public Git boundary
native grants / original arm proposal / ownership
files · not a new runtime database
work() runs Runtime.run_worker, TrustedTools.run and approval event delivery together. Each LocalApprovals object uses the same locked inbox. The helper serves only checks and arm; agents use
other authorized tools directly. Watchdog stopping does not depend on this worker. Host __init__ is package scaffolding; agent.md/goals.toml are instructions/configuration.
